title: Hearty Canadian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, slow-cooked beef stew featuring mustard seeds and a rich, beef broth. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Brown the flank steak in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Remove the steak from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, mustard seeds, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of beef broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the steak to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
